DE EBRIETATE
Mirum non est, quod hi Doctores doceant, ebrie-
tatem esse licitam ad vitandam mortem, quan-
do alii ad conservandam etiam salutem licere putant.
Pag. 70.

page.notes: The large initial M of "Mirum" is joined to the first word. The title block is set in spaced capitals and small italic; the "Pag. 70." line is a printed reference at the foot right. The printed "Pag. 70." and "eeeee 3" sit on one line and are kept as printed.
